user.title: Link to Xeonr Home Assistant Cloud
user.description:
Sign in with your Xeonr account and pick the team this Home Assistant belongs to. It gets a public URL through a Xeonr tunnel, TURN relays for camera streams, and off-site encrypted backups.

Your Xeonr sign-in is only used to link this instance; it is not stored here. Manage instances at {console_url}.

reauth_confirm.title: Relink to Xeonr Home Assistant Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: This instance's Xeonr credential was refused: it was unlinked in the console, or its credential was revoked. Sign in again to link it to your team.

data_description.team: The Xeonr team that will own this instance. You need the editor role in it, and the team must have Home Assistant Cloud enabled.

external_url.title: Use the tunnel as the external URL
external_url.description: Home Assistant has no external URL set. Set it to this instance's Xeonr URL, so the companion app, notifications and links work from outside your network?

progress.wait_for_device:
Open {url} and enter this code to sign in:

```
{code}
```

This page continues by itself once you have approved.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This Home Assistant is already linked.
abort.invalid_client: Xeonr sign-in is not available for this integration yet (the OAuth client is not registered).
abort.code_expired: The sign-in code expired. Start again.
abort.instance_limit: Your team has reached its Home Assistant instance limit. Remove an instance at {console_url} or raise the limit.
abort.product_not_enabled: Xeonr refused to link this instance: Home Assistant Cloud is not enabled for this team, or the sign-in is missing a permission. Check the team at {console_url}, then try again.
abort.not_editor: You need the editor role in this team to link an instance.

data.set_external_url: Use this instance's Xeonr URL as the external URL

data_description.set_external_url: Only applies while no other external URL is set. Turning it off clears the URL this integration set.

abort.external_url_set_by_user: The external URL is already set to {external_url}, so this integration leaves it alone. Clear it under Settings → System → Network to have it set to the tunnel URL.

remote_access_disabled.title: Remote access is switched off for {title}
remote_access_disabled.description: Remote access for this instance is switched off in the Xeonr console, so it has no public URL. Backups and camera relays still work. Turn it back on at {console_url}; this issue clears by itself within a few minutes.

confirm.title: Relink this instance
confirm.description: A team admin deleted this instance's hostname reservation in Burrow, so it can no longer be reached remotely. Relinking signs you in again and links this Home Assistant as a new instance with a new hostname.

instance_unlinked.title: {title} is no longer linked to Xeonr

confirm.title: Relink this instance
confirm.description: Xeonr refused this instance's credential: it was unlinked in the console ({console_url}), or its credential was revoked. Remote access, camera relays and backups are stopped. Relinking signs you in again and links this Home Assistant to your team.

agent_unavailable.title: Remote access could not start for {title}
agent_unavailable.description: The tunnel agent could not start: {error}. Reinstall the integration from HACS; if this persists, report it.
